name: The Unregistered Lantern
objective: The Winterwake registry counts every lantern. This year there is one more lantern than entries — and it is lit. Investigate the festival square.
intro: Nine hundred and twelve lanterns registered. Nine hundred and thirteen hanging above the square. The extra one is not like the others: it burns blue, and it was not there yesterday.
dialogue: Registry Clerk: "Nine hundred and twelve. I have counted them every Winterwake since I was six. There are nine hundred and thirteen."
Registry Clerk: "And the Lamplighter — the one who hangs them — has not been seen since the count."
lore_discovery: The blue lantern is not festival property. Its style predates the village itself.
